Initial approval CGA1047731 (10/14–11/30, 12 visits) had all 12 visits drawn by 11/18; series attendances 11/23, 11/25, 11/30, 12/02, 12/07 are unbilled; the one retro request (2026-12-01, visit_date 2026-11-25, 2 visits) covers 11/25 and 11/30; 12/02 and 12/07 lie inside the 14-day POS window (first day reached: 11/25) and carry no retro request → unmet.
